---
title: "Get Actor"
description: "Get a live actor by ID."
---

{/* Generated by scripts/docs/gen-api-reference.mjs from engine/artifacts/openapi.json and docs/api/endpoints.json. Do not edit by hand. */}

Returns `actor.not_found` for an actor that was destroyed or belongs to another namespace. A namespace token needs a grant on `actor` with `read`.

```http
GET https://rivet.example.com/actors/{actor_id}
```

## Examples

<CodeGroup>

```bash cURL
curl "https://rivet.example.com/actors/$ACTOR_ID?namespace=$RIVET_NAMESPACE" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RIVET_TOKEN"
```

</CodeGroup>

## Authentication

Send the admin token, or a namespace token from [Create Token](/docs/api/tokens/create) whose grants cover the request, as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header. The `x-rivet-token` header is also accepted. Routes with a `namespace` query parameter use the `default` namespace when it is omitted. See [Authentication](/docs/api/authentication).

## Path Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actor_id` | `string` | Yes | ID of the actor. |

## Query Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `string` | No | Name of the namespace to operate in. Defaults to `default`. |

## Responses

### 200

The actor.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actor` | `object` |  |
| `actor.actor_id` | `string` | Unique ID of the actor. |
| `actor.name` | `string` | Actor name as registered in your RivetKit registry. |
| `actor.key` | `string` | Actor key. Multi-part keys are joined with `/`, see [Actor Keys](/docs/api/actor-keys). An empty string for an actor without a key. |
| `actor.namespace` | `string` | Name of the namespace the actor belongs to. |
| `actor.runner_name_selector` | `string` | Node pool the actor runs in. |
| `actor.create_ts` | `integer` | When the actor was created, in Unix milliseconds. |
| `actor.start_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor first started. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actor.pending_allocation_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor started waiting for a node. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actor.connectable_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor last became connectable. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actor.sleep_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor went to sleep. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actor.reschedule_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor will next try to allocate. Not recorded by this version, so always `null`. |
| `actor.destroy_ts` | `integer \| null` | When the actor was destroyed, in Unix milliseconds. Only set in listings that include destroyed actors; otherwise `null`. |

```json
{
  "actor": {
    "actor_id": "d97pbq1nyqxw1w5qdwz0iirbqiblh2",
    "name": "my-actor",
    "key": "my-key",
    "namespace": "my-namespace",
    "runner_name_selector": "default",
    "create_ts": 1700000000000,
    "start_ts": null,
    "pending_allocation_ts": null,
    "connectable_ts": null,
    "sleep_ts": null,
    "reschedule_ts": null,
    "destroy_ts": null
  }
}
```

### 400

`envoy.invalid_namespace_name`: the `namespace` value is not a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `string` | Error group, for example `actor`. |
| `code` | `string` | Error code within the group, for example `not_found`. |
| `message` | `string` | Human-readable error message. |
| `metadata` | `any` | Extra details. Only present on some errors raised while authenticating or authorizing the request. |

```json
{
  "group": "envoy",
  "code": "invalid_namespace_name",
  "message": "Namespace name must be a DNS label of 1 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens."
}
```

| `metadata` | `any` | Extra details. Only present on some errors raised while authenticating or authorizing the request. |
